question: Oda-sama. Hellooooo. In the third panel of page 151 in volume 65, there's a squid standing next to Ikaros, so could he be "Daidalos"? That's right, that's gotta be right, that's surely how it is!!!? Friend Iwaken
answer: You don't have to push the issue so hard- yes, that's right! He was still alive at the time, and those two were best buddies. But Daidalos ended up dying and becoming dried squid in an unforeseen accident. Because of the trauma from that incident, Ikaros developed a fear of becoming dried squid himself whenever he sees fire.
name: Chagero's Friend Iwaken
